digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Today is Monday, August 3, with six meetings plus one protected block. The SMS Journey scope-and-risk discussion and the Salesforce red-project review are the main anchors; the Firstfire/AWS concern and the remaining Court and Amazon Connect inputs are the clearest risks. Four high-value items carry forward and six items are urgent. The dashboard state last changed Thursday, July 30, so weekend completion status may be stale. Teams returned mostly empty thread stubs, so this brief relies more heavily on calendar, recent email, and dashboard continuity.

items.label: Finish routing the Court and Phase 2 intake batch
items.detail: Confirm ownership and priority for the remaining requests. Katie described the Court number-visibility request as Court's number-two priority and asked that it move quickly.

items.label: Close the Amazon Connect quota and user-count inputs
items.detail: Confirm owners for the user list, phone-number, concurrent-call, and go-live user-count questions so setup does not stay blocked.

items.label: Continue Latent Variables testing and reply to Yash
items.detail: Finish enough testing to give Yash a clear response or take the offered call; this evaluation has remained open across several digests.

items.label: Review the SMS consent-management framework
items.detail: Use Lucia's updated consent language across Litify/Salesforce and SMS Magic to sharpen today's SMS Journey scope, phase, and risk decisions.

items.label: 8:00 AM - Approve Timecards & Prepare for the Week
items.detail: Start with timecard approval and week setup before the decision-heavy meeting run.

items.label: 10:00 AM - Legal Change Management - IT & EPMO Sync
items.detail: Use the sync to close doubts, owners, and action items between EPMO and the IT SharePoint team.

items.label: 11:30 AM - SMS Journey Project Touchpoint
items.detail: Primary decision anchor for aligning scope, phases, and risks. Bring the consent-management framework into the discussion.

items.label: 12:00 PM - Blocked Space; 12:30 PM Salesforce Steering
items.detail: The steering committee consumes the final 30 minutes of the protected block. Review red-project health and the program timeline pre-read before 12:30 PM.

items.label: 2:00 PM - BD Portfolio Review
items.detail: Review active-project status, blockers, and new intake; convert the discussion into owners and next steps.

items.label: 3:00 PM - 1:1 Maria & Jean
items.detail: Close the day on portfolio roadblocks and next steps that remain after the BD review.

items.label: Prepare the Salesforce red-project review
items.detail: Read the July 31 steering pre-read, identify the projects in red, and be ready to name the timeline decisions, critical risks, and blockers leadership needs to address.

items.label: Address the Firstfire and AWS concerns
items.detail: Nadia recommended ending the Firstfire partnership after go-live and flagged another concern from SaltClick. Confirm the immediate IT owner, what must be stabilized, and what should be escalated.

items.label: Review the SCV UAT deployment update
items.detail: SaltClick sent Friday's SCV UAT status. Check whether the deployment update introduces a blocker, missed dependency, or decision that belongs in today's Salesforce review.

items.label: Lock owners for BD and Maria roadblocks
items.detail: Use the 2:00 PM portfolio review and 3:00 PM 1:1 as one decision sequence: surface the few material blockers, assign owners, and set the next checkpoint.

items.label: Tuesday starts with the Jhara 1:1 and protected time
items.detail: The 10:30 AM portfolio and roadblock check-in is followed by a noon focus block, offering a clean path for Legal Change Management follow-through.

items.label: EPMO leadership and portfolio meetings stack from 2:00 PM
items.detail: The recreated EPMO TL Weekly Catch Up runs at 2:00 PM, followed by Nicolas at 3:30 PM and the CSC portfolio review at 4:00 PM. Sara is working from the Dublin office through Friday.
